The *Tirokuṭṭapetavatthu* (Pv 5) is a verse text in the *Petavatthu* collection of the Khuddaka Nikāya. In this discourse, the Buddha explains the practice and significance of sharing merit with departed relatives (*petas*).

A full parallel to the text is preserved in the *Khuddakapāṭha* as the *Tirokuṭṭa Sutta* (Kp 7 / PTS Kp 6).
